quote: The signature カラシソバ is dressed with a mustard-vinegar-soy-sauce blend; standard Japanese soy sauce contains wheat, so the sauce as well as the noodles carry gluten.
found: 「ゆでた中華麺をカラシ醤油で和え、その上に鶏ガラと昆布でとったスープのあんをかけるというもので…麺を和えるカラシが水や湯ではなく、京都の地酢で溶かれているのも特徴だ。」/「〈鳳舞楼〉ではワンタン用の小麦粉にセモリナ粉を配合して麺を自家製。」
method: route 1 -- plain curl; Tabelog 26040920 fetched separately with an iPhone UA (200) to check menu and trading status
note: LOUD, and the record is UNDER-stating its own evidence. Brutus does not merely imply wheat: it says 鳳舞楼 makes its noodles from ワンタン用の小麦粉 blended with セモリナ粉 -- semolina is durum wheat, so the noodle is doubly, explicitly wheat and the record can stop hedging with 'soy sauce normally contains wheat'. The shop's Tabelog repeats it: 「セモリナ粉で作る歯ごたえ抜群な特注麺に辛子あんをかけた当店の名物料理」. TRANSPLANT WARNING for the record's other lines: the 春巻/シュウマイ and 酢豚 that gf_detail and vegan_detail attribute to this shop appear in the Brutus article under OTHER shops (鳳泉's ハルマキ・シュウマイ, 龍鳳's 餃子). Those items are genuinely on 鳳舞楼's menu, but the evidence is Tabelog 26040920 (春巻き・焼売・紅油水餃子・酢豚・エビチリ in the banquet courses), not Brutus -- recite them there. Also note the Brutus piece places the shop at 新町中立売; it has since moved to 上京区今出川町333 第2高橋ビル5F (Tabelog: 「※このお店は以前の場所から移転しています」), which the record already reflects correctly.

quote: Even the plant-leaning soy milk yuzu bowl is finished with roasted bacon, and broths are animal-based; no vegan preparation is described.

Checked for the mistranslation trap and the record is CLEAN in both directions: it reads 豆乳 correctly as soy milk (and the page itself says 生クリームではなく), so it does not falsely warn a vegan off a dairy bowl -- the disqualifier really is the ローストしたベーコン garnish. Two small over-reaches to trim: the page attributes つくね・煮卵・チャーシュー only to 一蓮 (紗's toppings are not listed), and it lists a 生ゆば丼 550円 side that the record's 'nothing plant-based' framing skips. vegan_status: no is still correct -- bacon on the only soy-based bowl, no vegan statement anywhere. Also: /shopinfo/ gives 定休日 水曜日, which the record's hours_raw omits.

quote: All ramen is built on chicken-and-pork-bone broth with back-fat, pork chashu, and menma -- no plant-based broth is offered or separated.
found: 「コクのある香り豊かな背脂を浮かせた自信の一杯。…自家製のチャーシューとメンマをトッピング。醤油ベースの鶏ガラ豚骨ラーメンです。」/「チャーシュー用の豚肉はブロックの状態からお店で部位ごとに切り分け、調理します。」
note: Back-fat, chicken-and-pork-bone broth, pork chashu and menma are all on the shop's own page; a single ramen is described, so 'all ramen' holds. One over-reach to fix in gf_detail, not here: the record says the karaage is 'wheat-batter', but the page describes only the marinade -- 「〝唐揚げ〟は鶏肉を秘伝の醤油ダレに漬け込み、寝かせる事で旨味を凝縮」. The soy-tare marinade is the real gluten route and is quotable; the batter is not evidenced (karaage coating is often potato starch). Reword to the marinade. Hours and the six-shop network on the record match the site's 店舗一覧 exactly; 西院本店 open, 定休日 不定休.
